title: Woah! My mall was replaced by a giant water world labyrinth for the first time
content: In last night's dream, my usual mall was gone, but I was in some kind of water facility - a mix between industrial, like a water treatment plant, academic institution, and natural waterfalls and pools. Oddly, I was still LOOKING FOR MY CAR, which is what I do in the mall world. Unlike mall world, I was hiding from someone (not sure who or why) and going through multiple tunnels and levels and passageways, walking, running, swimming, even going underwater and seeing aquatic creatures. There were lots of other people doing their things, including what looked like college students in creative arts classes, and it felt mostly underground. Anyone else experience a water world?
